integrity: The proof is analytic for every odd prime at least five; a standalone integer-arithmetic script provides finite corroboration and does not establish the universal result. Independent validation is outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Four equal-modulus coefficients and the standard prime-field quadratic-chirp Fourier transform only. No claims for unequal magnitudes, other support sizes, or composite moduli. The September 2026 closely related preprint's full text could not be inspected; its abstract supports the broader unrestricted bound but is not used as evidence of absence of a flat-amplitude specialization.
title: Flat four-point finite-parabola Fourier zeros: a prime-field symmetry dichotomy
